_secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_INFO_PLIST: EAS file secret — upload with: eas secret:create --scope project --name GOOGLE_SERVICES_INFO_PLIST --type file --value ./GoogleService-Info.plist

google_services_ios_verification.description: Steps to verify GOOGLE_SERVICES_INFO_PLIST EAS secret is wired correctly before an App Store submission.
google_services_ios_verification.wiring_confirmed: app.config.js ios.googleServicesFile reads process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICES_INFO_PLIST with a local fallback — confirmed 2026-06-10.
pre_build_checklist: 1. Confirm the secret exists: run `eas secret:list` and check GOOGLE_SERVICES_INFO_PLIST appears with type=file.
2. If missing, upload it: eas secret:create --scope project --name GOOGLE_SERVICES_INFO_PLIST --type file --value ./GoogleService-Info.plist
3. Confirm the file contains the correct bundle ID (com.the147bradford.app) and EAS project ID (3f31dfb1-b149-43ca-ab9a-91b6d7cb230a).
success_criteria: Build log shows 'GoogleService-Info.plist' copied into the iOS bundle (search for 'GoogleService' in the EAS build log).
No 'missing GoogleService-Info.plist' or 'file not found' Xcode error in the build output.
google_services_ios_verification.failure_recovery: If the build errors with a missing plist, re-upload the secret (step 2 above) and re-run. The env var is injected by EAS at build time — it is not present during local `expo start`.
